abstract.text: Use the web map to find a place or inspect a coordinate.

inlineContent.text: Type a place or address in Search and choose a suggestion or result. The map moves to the selected place and shows its details when available. You can also enter a latitude and longitude pair, choose Show on map, and use Copy to share the coordinate text.
Search results are map places; your Project Locations remain available when you change the search selection.

abstract.text: Explore your Projects and places in a browser.
Use the Project selector above the web map to choose the Project you want to view.
